svg.aria-label: The DABstep loop as one ring that runs in two modes. Supervised: the ten-task dev split feeds a run of the champion, every task is traced, the vendored scorer grades each answer, one Sonnet 5 optimiser session reads every failure and writes only the next version's prompt and helper, the challenger runs on the same ten, and a one-sided exact McNemar test on the paired flips promotes or holds. Unsupervised: a seeded probe of 47 of the 450 runs unscored in two passes, gold-free signals and twelve family cards replace the failures in the optimiser's prompt, and gate A promotes only if no dev task broke and the paired signals improved. Either way the registry records the verdict, CI re-scores the champion, and a reflection pass writes what the next optimiser should know. Off the ring sit the single model choke point and the write guard with its checksum.

g.title: 01 · the input — supervised: data/tasks/dev.jsonl, ten tasks with gold. Unsupervised: loop/sampler.py draws a seeded, stratified probe of the 450 by family, boundary tasks first, never a dev id, plus the siblings each invariant needs; 47 tasks at k = 3, seed 0. The 450 are never scored

02 · run — eval/runner.py: one agent version on one split at three workers behind an asyncio semaphore; writes runs/<id>/run.json, results.jsonl, traces/ and the submission file; run folders are immutable once scored

03 · trace — runs/<id>/traces/<task>.json: turns, input and output tokens, cost, duration, terminal reason and final text for every task; tracking/mlflow_log.py indexes the run with agent, fingerprint, model and code SHA

04 · score or signal — supervised: eval/scorer.py vendored verbatim from the benchmark space, exact match per task. Unsupervised: loop/signals.py computes S1 method consistency, S2 two-pass agreement, S3 metamorphic invariants between sibling answers and S5 format compliance from the run folder alone; nothing reads a gold answer

05 · optimise — loop/optimiser.py: one ClaudeSDKClient session on claude-sonnet-5 at high effort, shown both champion surfaces, the ledger history and any held challenger. Supervised: every failed task with its gold and a condensed trace. Unsupervised: the twelve family cards, worst status first, and both traces of every failed invariant; it may verify against an invariant, never against a leaderboard answer

06 · write v(N+1) — the session may write agents/v(N+1)/system.md and helper.py only; agent.yaml must be byte-identical; it must verify helper changes against the gold in-session and finish with diagnosis.json carrying a per-edit change log
07 · register — tracking/registry.py: the challenger is registered with its fingerprint and run id; loop/registry.json keeps an append-only history of every promote and register event

08 · gate — eval/compare.py. Supervised: a one-sided exact McNemar test on the paired dev flips, alpha 0.05. Unsupervised, gate A: the challenger re-runs dev-10 scored and the same probe unscored; promote only if no dev task broke and the paired gold-free composite improved. The verdict lands on loop/ledger.jsonl whether it promotes or holds

09 · deploy — tracking/gate.py re-scores the champion's committed results in CI and checks its fingerprint against the registry; a green main deploys by OIDC to ECR and App Runner, and demo_smoke.sh asserts demo mode, a registered champion, 450 tasks and a declined question

10 · reflect — read-only Sonnet passes that write for the next optimiser. loop/reflect.py over the champion's dev traces found why v1 broke 1871. loop/ureflect.py over a probe writes one card per family to loop/families/Fnn.json: canonical method, entry point, prompt rule, status verified, provisional or open
11 · next cycle — the promoted challenger is the champion; a held challenger stays on the ledger and is offered to the next optimiser as a starting point, not a rejected one

llm.py — the single model choke point: haiku for the agent under test, sonnet for the optimiser and reflection; require_live() refuses to build a model under DEMO_MODE=1, and a subscription session has the API key stripped from its environment

the write guard — a PreToolUse hook denies any Write, Edit or MultiEdit outside agents/v(N+1)/ and any edit to agent.yaml; a checksum over ten guarded paths is compared after the session and any change voids the cycle
